description_expanded: Located in the Gulfview Heights community in Santa Rosa Beach on Scenic 30A, Eventide is a beautifully renovated five-bedroom vacation home with four full baths, two half baths, a refreshing private pool, and stylish accommodations for up to 14 beach-loving guests. Equipped with dual living quarters, kitchens, and dining spaces, this spacious three-story retreat is ideal for extended families or groups of friends traveling together—offering room to gather and room to spread out for a little well-earned downtime. The second floor hosts the heart of the home: a light-filled open living, dining, and kitchen area that's as functional as it is beautiful. The main kitchen is a designer's dream, with mint green cabinetry, open oak shelving, butcher block countertops, a deep farmhouse sink, and stainless steel appliances—all tied together with handcrafted-style backsplash tile that adds texture and coastal charm. It opens to a sunny dining space and a relaxed, breezy living room wrapped in windows. Slipcovered seating surrounds a rustic coffee table, while tropical accents and soft area rugs create a welcoming space for everyone to relax. Glass doors lead out to a large, shaded balcony—perfect for coffee, cocktails, or catching the breeze from the nearby Gulf. Also on the second floor, you'll find a serene king bedroom suite with balcony access and a private ensuite bath featuring a walk-in shower, as well as a convenient powder room for guests. Downstairs on the first floor, a second living area offers an inviting hangout zone with plush furnishings and patio access just steps from the pool. The second full kitchen mirrors the home's updated aesthetic with modern appliances, stylish finishes, and seating at the bar for casual bites. The adjacent dining area comfortably seats six for meals or game night. This level also includes a king guest bedroom with a walk-in shower, an additional flex space styled as a private office with a full-size sleeper sofa, a half bath, and a laundry room. On the third floor, the primary king suite feels like a private oasis with its own breezy balcony and luxury ensuite bath. From this balcony, you'll enjoy partial Gulf views from three different vantage points—perfect for sipping coffee with a sunrise or watching the sky melt into sunset. The bathroom features a deep soaking tub, a walk-in shower, and dual vanities set in warm wood countertops. Also on this level is a large guest bedroom that includes two queen beds and a twin bunk—making it ideal for kids, teens, or cousins who love to crash together. This room enjoys a private bath with a tub/shower combination, charming decorative tile, and a private balcony with treetop views. Outside, Eventide lives up to its name. The private backyard features a refreshing pool surrounded by lush greenery, sun loungers, and plenty of space to unwind in the Florida sunshine. Whether you're swimming, grilling, or just soaking in the salt air, this space is made for memory-making. Tucked just a few blocks from the beach in a quiet, laid-back neighborhood, this home is perfectly placed for enjoying everything Scenic 30A has to offer. Within easy walking distance, Goatfeathers serves up both a fresh seafood market and a casual restaurant—perfect for grabbing local catches to grill by the pool or sitting down for a no-fuss meal out. Just a short drive or bike ride away, Gulf Place is buzzing with cafes, art galleries, live music, and local flavor. Whether you're planning a reunion, a group getaway, or just want the extra space to stretch out, Eventide offers the style, comfort, and location to make your next beach vacation unforgettable. First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Office/Bedroom with Full Sleeper Sofa, Powder Room, Laundry. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, Powder Room. Third Floor: King Primary Bedroom with  Balcony Access and  Luxury Bath with Tub/Shower Combo, Two Queen Bedroom with Twin Bunk and Tub/Shower Combo + Balcony Access. *Add $50.00 per day to heat the pool (available October - April if needed).
